Farmers Protest Dairy Election Rule Change in Maharashtra

Thousands of farmers protested in Maharashtra against a rule change by the BJP government concerning the Gokul Dairy elections. The farmers allege a conspiracy to take over the dairy and are protesting the ordinance. The protest involved farmers and their cattle on the streets.
